GenAiPlugin.description: Handles requests to assess the legal compliance of MLR submission documents.
GenAiPlugin.scope: Handle requests to pre-screen an MLR submission for legal compliance, including FTC advertising standards, Lanham Act comparative advertising rules, and Anti-Kickback Statute requirements. Use this topic when the user asks about legal review, legal compliance, deceptive claims, comparative advertising, or wants to run a legal pre-screen on a submission. Do not handle medical accuracy questions or regulatory FDA labeling questions — those are separate topics.
